summary: Unpinned github: dependency source resolves and installs mutable third-party code
details: package.json declares `libsignal` as `github:Kelvdra/libsignal` — an off-registry, mutable git source with no commit SHA, no version pin, and no integrity check. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever the referenced GitHub tree contains at that moment and installs it, executing any lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) the fetched repository declares. Whoever controls the `Kelvdra/libsignal` repository controls arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at install time. The dependency name `libsignal` also mirrors the well-known WhatsApp/Signal library commonly consumed via the Baileys ecosystem, but resolution is redirected to an author-owned GitHub tree rather than a pinned registry release. The static `ping` rule hit in lib/Utils/generics.js is a keyword co-occurrence in an ID/version generation helper and does not itself indicate exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
